artifacts.enantiomorph:
Through the Alpha's growl, the pack-leaders dug out twelve hunting grounds, over each of which a triad of jaws would patrol.³⁰ [*The full muster of thirty-six ranked beasts and twelve hunting grounds is presented below with bone-pile.*]


**The Thirty-Six Ranked Beasts:**


The name of the first is the Lame Elk, who in coat looks as if he has had a dragging hindleg.³¹


The second is the Split-Hoof, who is not one flank, but two torn halves.³²


The third is the Alpha Whelp.³³


The fourth is the Scald-Crow.


The fifth is the Ghost-Stag, but not the Stag-That-Returned.³⁴


The sixth is the Burrowing Mole.


The fifth is the Feral Sow.³⁵


The sixth is the Blind Catfish.³⁶


The seventh is Aslan.³⁷


The eighth is the Purring Lynx.


The ninth is the Iridescent Beetle.


The tenth is the Laughing Hyena.


The eleventh is the River-Horse.


The twelfth is the Lone Howler.


The thirteenth is the Pale Moth, but not the Moth-That-Returned.


The fourteenth is the White Mare.


The fifteenth, the Bull-Frog.³⁸


The sixteenth is the Herd-Bull.


The seventeenth is the Gilt Rooster.


The eighteenth is the Armadillo.


The nineteenth is the Marking-Scent.³⁹


The twentieth is the Rabid Weasel.


The twenty-first is the Carrion Hawk.


The twenty-second is the Silver Serpent.⁴⁰


The twenty-third is the Litter.


The twenty-fourth is the Crab-Apple Wasp.


The twenty-fifth is the Dung Beetle.⁴¹


The twenty-sixth is the Fenced Range.


The twenty-seventh is the Regurgitating She-Wolf.⁴²


The twenty-eighth is the Burrowing Owl.⁴³


The twenty-ninth is the Tracking Hound.


The thirtieth is the Firefly Swarm.


The thirty-first is the Horned Foal.


The thirty-second is the Bone-White Raven.⁴⁴


The thirty-third is the Armored Rhinoceros.


The thirty-fourth is the Mounting-Reflex.⁴⁵


The thirty-fifth is the Exposed Organ.


And the thirty-sixth is the Albino Mink, who is set over the deepest burrow of the Warren.⁴⁶


And the number of the nocturnal-diurnal territories is thirty-six.


**The Twelve Hunting Grounds:**


The loveliest is the Salt Lick, where the Alpha himself holds the kill


Then the Fog Marsh


The Fasting Den


The Fire-Ant Mound


The Antler-Rack


The Red Dust Flat


The First-Fruit Thicket


The Baited Clearing


The Watering Truce


The Lean Season


The Torch-Lit Cave


And the Warren⁴⁷


These are the twelve hunting grounds of creature. Three pack-leaders crouched in dominance over each, and through them the Alpha crouched in dominance over all.
